official_identifier.why: 367/QD-TTg is on the stored Can Tho article; the OCR of the PDF reads the number as '36 F'. I rendered page 1 of the stored PDF and read 'So: 367/QD-TTg' and 'Ha Noi, ngay 28 thang 02 nam 2026' on the page image.

notes.why: The sentence about Decision 2835/QĐ-TTg of 31 Dec 2025 appears in no stored text; the rest of the notes is supported (effect on signature, dates, tasks delivered per VN-04 to VN-06).

fix.value: The decision is dated Hà Nội, 28 February 2026 and takes effect on signature; the Government portal's digital signature on the published copy is dated 3 March 2026, and the Can Tho city legal-education portal gives 3 March 2026 as the signing date. The Plan also tasks the Ministry of Education and Training with a national AI workforce programme and the Ministry of Science and Technology with establishing the National AI Development Fund (2026-2027). Tasks since delivered include Decree 142/2026/NĐ-CP (30 Apr 2026), Circular 05/2026/TT-BKHCN issuing the national AI ethics framework (10 Mar 2026) and Decision 33/2026/QĐ-TTg listing high-risk AI systems (30 Jun 2026).

evidence.quote: Điều 2. Quyết định này có hiệu lực thi hành kể từ ngày ký ban hành.

summary_claims.claim: Plan sets a review of the national AI strategy at least every three years (II.4(a): 'it nhat 03 nam mot lan')

Decree on Law, decree on National AI Development Fund, PM decisions on dataset list and high-risk list, MoST circular on ethics framework, each 'Thoi han trinh: Thang 2/2026' (deadline to submit). Summary's 'all due in Feb 2026' is looser than 'to be submitted in Feb 2026'

note: Summary matches the Vietnamese plan (tasks, lead bodies, three-year strategy review, portal, databases, shared infrastructure, inspection; the workforce programme is in notes). Date and number are supported (checked on the page image). One notes sentence about Decision 2835/QD-TTg has no stored support; the fix removes it. Suggest the summary say 'to be submitted in Feb 2026' rather than 'due'. A targeted search found no newer instrument.
